body:
Abilify and Methamphetamine Interaction
I have been on Abilify (and also lamotrigine) for three years, and smoking meth for two of those years.
I was on meth for a few years before taking Abilify (I was on the lamotrigine for a few years before taking abilify), and used to feel the effects of the meth upon smoking it. I realize that my tolerance is probably high, but in my experience, abilify completely counteracts the effects of meth.  Since starting Abilify I feel literally nothing when I smoke. I could even fall asleep right after smoking.  At the same time, I still crave the meth as I feel generally tired from the two psych meds.
I was unable to find much information on this drug combination, so I wanted to write my experience.
